base.desc: the FL 2026 fixture (4 VST channels, automation channel, audio clip, 1 pattern, mixer FX), neutral names

empty.desc: no patterns, no channels, no clips: header + arrangement + mixer only

one_channel.desc: a single plugin channel with its notes and one pattern clip

one_channel_no_notes.desc: a single plugin channel, one empty pattern, nothing in the playlist

patterns_1000.desc: 1000 patterns with 2 notes each, every one placed once in the playlist

audio_clips.desc: 3 audio clips added by flp_add_audio_clip (overlapping, same and different tracks)

automation_clips.desc: volume, pan and plugin-parameter automation clips added by flp_add_automation

tempo_automation.desc: a tempo lane (flp_tempo_write) plus an automation clip linked to the global tempo

layers.desc: a layer channel (type 3) whose children are channels 0 and 1, name with Cyrillic

arrangements_3.desc: 3 arrangements: the original, a shifted copy with extra clips, and an empty one

timesig_markers.desc: 3/4 project, markers (one with CJK), time signature changes 7/8 and 4/4, 6/8 at bar 1

odd_meters.desc: time signature marker at tick 0 (6/8), a 5/4 and a 13/16, duplicate marker ticks

names_unicode.desc: non-ASCII names everywhere: channels, patterns, arrangement, markers, project info

names_long.desc: 5000-character names (channel, pattern, title, marker) and an empty channel name

missing_samples.desc: sampler/audio channels pointing at missing, relative, %FLStudioUserData%, UNC and empty paths

unknown_plugins.desc: unknown plugin names with random state blobs (instrument and mixer effect), empty state

zero_length.desc: empty notes events, a pattern with no data group, zero-length clips, a 0-tick note

notes_edges.desc: notes at tick 0 and on the clip's last tick, velocity 0/127/128 (FL's max)/255, keys 0/127/131 (FL's top key), 1-tick notes

notes_far.desc: a note at tick 2^31 and a clip reaching it (a song 'millions of bars' long)

overlapping_clips.desc: the same pattern 6 times overlapping on one track and stacked across tracks, offset clips

track_500.desc: a pattern clip on the last playlist track (500) and an automation clip on track 499

muted_all.desc: every clip muted and every channel switched off

fl20_header.desc: the base project saved as FL 20.8.4.2576 (version events only; FL 2024+ clip layout kept)

fl21_header.desc: the base project saved as FL 21.2.3.4004 (version events only; FL 2024+ clip layout kept)

fl24_header.desc: the base project saved as FL 24.1.2.4430 (version events only; FL 2024+ clip layout kept)

fl25_header.desc: the base project saved as FL 25.1.6.4997 (version events only; FL 2024+ clip layout kept)

legacy_playlist32.desc: FL 20-style 32-byte playlist records (PyFLP layout), 11 clips = 352 bytes = 4 x 88

legacy_playlist60.desc: FL 21-style 60-byte playlist records (PyFLP layout), 22 clips = 1320 bytes = 15 x 88

ppq_960.desc: PPQ 960 with every note and clip position rescaled

no_tempo_event.desc: no project tempo event (156) and no recorded tempo

split_notes.desc: a pattern whose notes are split over two notes events (224) and a second pattern with a controller event only

channel_gaps.desc: channel indexes 0, 5, 17, 40, 41, 300 (non-contiguous) with notes and links following

unnamed_last_channel.desc: the last channel has no name event (FL leaves default names out)

many_patterns_writers.desc: 6 named patterns made by flp_new_pattern and placed, plus notes via flp_add_notes

mixed_kitchen_sink.desc: unicode + markers + automation + audio + 3 arrangements + muted clips together
